Equipment
 LC 105 A Energized Contact Logic Output Module 
 Alstom -
 France

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
 weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.

The LC105A is a 
logic output module providing 16 make contacts supplied by the positive polarity 
of the process voltage. The outputs are 
current-sourcing outputs.

sections.text: Controls and Indications on The Front Panel

A green LED on 
the front panel indicates that the module is working.

It remains on if 
the module is operating correctly and goes off in case of faulty operation 
(fault detected in the configuration, hardware or use of the module).

The module includes 16 
logic outputs built from monostable relays with make contacts. Each relay 
winding is energized by two transistors, one providing the +12V voltage and the 
other the 0V. The controls of these transistors are separated and complemented.

The risk of an untimely 
output is thus very low.
A protection against overloads is connected in series with each contact.

The process 
voltage is supplied by the backplane connector (distributed voltage), or by the 
process connector (external voltage).

A logic 
input based on an opto-isolator indicates the presence of the process voltage.

General protection on the 
process voltage +Vp by CTP with maximum tripping current at 20C: 0.45 A.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 
 weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the title block.
The LC105A is a 
logic output module providing 16 make contacts supplied by the positive polarity 
of the process voltage. The outputs are 
current-sourcing outputs.
Dimension:

Operation :
The LC105A module includes:
A process interface consisting of:
16 logic outputs based on monostable relays with make contacts, 
 individually protected against short-circuits.
A process voltage distribution and monitoring circuit,
A short-circuit detection circuit
An interface with the 2000 I/O backplane consisting of:
A circuit for plugging in with power on,
A 2000 I/O bus slave interface,
Input-output registers,
Controls and Indications on The Front Panel
A green LED on 
the front panel indicates that the module is working.
It remains on if 
the module is operating correctly and goes off in case of faulty operation 
(fault detected in the configuration, hardware or use of the module).
Output Elements
The module includes 16 
logic outputs built from monostable relays with make contacts. Each relay 
winding is energized by two transistors, one providing the +12V voltage and the 
other the 0V. The controls of these transistors are separated and complemented.
The risk of an untimely 
output is thus very low.
A protection against overloads is connected in series with each contact.
Process Voltage
The process 
voltage is supplied by the backplane connector (distributed voltage), or by the 
process connector (external voltage).
A logic 
input based on an opto-isolator indicates the presence of the process voltage.
Protection
General protection on the 
process voltage +Vp by CTP with maximum tripping current at 20C: 0.45 A.
